excerpt: We source certain components from a limited number of suppliers and depend on third parties for some manufacturing, assembly, testing and packaging services.
We have significant concentration of supply chain dependency on certain third-party manufacturers, particularly for advanced process nodes used in high-performance and AI products.
Government export restrictions on advanced AI accelerators may limit our ability to sell certain products into restricted markets and could affect future revenue opportunities.
A limited number of customers and partners account for a meaningful share of revenue associated with accelerated computing products.
Demand for cloud and AI infrastructure may require significant capital investment and execution discipline across datacenter capacity planning.
